name: Fondi
tagline: Reads your company's website and staffs you a leadership bench of bots
description: Aimed at people building alone. It works through whatever your company already publishes about itself, forms a picture of the business, then creates specialist assistants to match, standing in for the heads of function a one-person outfit cannot afford to hire. The bench is shaped around your company, not generic.
author: Naoufal
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
